scenarios.prompt: White to move. Checkmate the lone king with your king and two bishops. Every legal move is allowed; the computer defends.
scenarios.explanation: The two bishops side by side make a wall the enemy king cannot cross. Push the king towards a corner with the bishops, bring your own king up to take the squares beside it, and mate in the corner. Leave the enemy king a move until the mate, or it is stalemate; and keep both bishops, because one bishop cannot mate.
hints: Put the bishops next to each other: together they cut off two diagonals at once.
Mate happens in a corner: drive the king there, and bring your king close before the last checks.
